Then  

\[
a-b=2^{1/3}\quad\text{and}\quad a^{3}-b^{3}= (13x+37)-(13x-37)=74 .
\]

Using the factorisation \(a^{3}-b^{3}=(a-b)(a^{2}+ab+b^{2})\),

\[
2^{1/3}\bigl(a^{2}+ab+b^{2}\bigr)=74
\;\Longrightarrow\;
a^{2}+ab+b^{2}= \frac{74}{2^{1/3}} .
\tag{1}
\]

Write \(b=a-2^{1/3}\) (from \(a-b=2^{1/3}\)) and substitute in (1):

\[
a^{2}+a(a-2^{1/3})+(a-2^{1/3})^{2}
=3a^{2}-3\cdot2^{1/3}a+2^{2/3}= \frac{74}{2^{1/3}} .
\]

Since \(2^{2/3}= \frac{2}{2^{1/3}}\), this simplifies to  

\[
a^{2}-2^{1/3}a-\frac{24}{2^{1/3}}=0 .

\[
a^{2}2^{1/3}-2a-24=0 .
